history.recommendation_text: The Board reiterates its recommendation that the Administration continue its efforts, including the implementation of innovation initiatives, to realize the target recruitment time of 120 days for filling vacant posts.
history.administration_response: The Administration notes that, while the Board has reviewed evidence of the new tools introduced to assist entities in meeting the 120-day target, the Secretariat has not achieved the desired level of performance. An analysis of the factors affecting performance has been completed as part of a change management study conducted by an external consultant during the fourth quarter of 2021 and the first quarter of 2022. The key findings and recommendations are currently being shared with the client entities, which have delegation of authority for recruitment activities.
history.board_assessment: Given that new tools have been introduced to expedite the recruitment process and that the 120-day target has not yet been met, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board reiterated its recommendation that the Administration continue its efforts, including the implementation of innovation initiatives, to realize the target recruitment time of 120 days for filling vacant posts.
history.administration_response: Since 2019, the Administration has introduced eight new recruitment tools to support heads of entity in the efficient exercise of their delegated authority for recruitment and meet the 120-day target to fill vacant posts. In 2022, the timeline for selections averaged 156 days (a 16 per cent improvement compared with 185 days in 2021) based on 2,333 selections recorded in Inspira. The time to fill 1,710 regular job openings averaged 185 days and the time to fill 623 recruit-from-roster job openings averaged 79 days. With regard to Secretariat entities that have not achieved the desired level of performance, the Administration is consulting with them to explore ways to meet the target recruitment timelines.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration has introduced eight new recruitment tools to support heads of entity in the efficient exercise of their delegated authority for recruitment and meet the 120-day target to fill vacant posts, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
